answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. Admission requires 4 GB of sequential memory per key, so one rack cannot mint a thousand parallel identities. Trust accrues only through verified work; a crystal of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady marble at 10 percent per epoch, and basalt-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
